en: A colorized historic postcard showing the ornate façade and terrace of the Grand Hotel Pupp with people in early‑20th‑century fashion strolling and sitting at cafe tables in front of the building. The hotel's name appears on the façade and the caption at the top reads "Karlsbad, Grand Hôtel Pupp." Additional small red text is printed vertically on the right margin and at the lower right corner.
